metadata.description: Query the Armis Knowledge base — organizational standards, CWE remediation, framework and technology guidance — directly from your coding agent. Ships an MCP variant (works with Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.) and a Claude-Code-only shell-skills variant (no MCP runtime, OS keychain auth) for each environment. Pick one variant per environment — both variants register the same slash commands, so installing both simultaneously will collide.

plugins.name: armis-knowledge-dev
plugins.description: MCP variant, DEV environment (knowledge-mcp.moose-dev.armis.com). Adds /knowledge-dev, /ask-dev, /cwe-fix-dev, /framework-guidance-dev, and /tech-guidance-dev. Reads ARMIS_CLIENT_ID, ARMIS_CLIENT_SECRET, and ARMIS_TENANT_ID; exchanges them for a short-lived JWT on startup. Tenant isolation enforced server-side; no knowledge data stored on disk.

plugins.name: armis-knowledge-stage
plugins.description: MCP variant, STAGE environment (knowledge-mcp.moose-stg.armis.com). Adds /knowledge, /ask, /cwe-fix, /framework-guidance, and /tech-guidance. Reads ARMIS_CLIENT_ID, ARMIS_CLIENT_SECRET, and ARMIS_TENANT_ID; exchanges them for a short-lived JWT on startup. Tenant isolation enforced server-side; no knowledge data stored on disk.

plugins.name: armis-knowledge-skills-dev
plugins.description: Shell-skills variant, DEV environment (knowledge-api.moose-dev.armis.com). Same /knowledge-dev, /cwe-fix-dev, /framework-guidance-dev, /tech-guidance-dev commands as the MCP variant, but implemented as pure shell skills that hit the REST API directly via curl — no MCP runtime, no Python install. Reads ARMIS_KNOWLEDGE_CLIENT_ID and ARMIS_KNOWLEDGE_TENANT_SLUG; loads client_secret from the OS keychain (service: armis-knowledge-dev). Claude Code only. Don't install alongside armis-knowledge-dev — same slash commands.

plugins.name: armis-knowledge-skills-stage
plugins.description: Shell-skills variant, STAGE environment (knowledge-api.moose-stg.armis.com). Same /knowledge, /cwe-fix, /framework-guidance, /tech-guidance commands as the MCP variant, but implemented as pure shell skills that hit the REST API directly via curl — no MCP runtime, no Python install. Reads ARMIS_KNOWLEDGE_CLIENT_ID and ARMIS_KNOWLEDGE_TENANT_SLUG; loads client_secret from the OS keychain (service: armis-knowledge-stage). Claude Code only. Don't install alongside armis-knowledge-stage — same slash commands.
